title: On her card
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The instructor checks the Daumier out on her own card and hands it to him in the hall. 'Two weeks. I never did this.' The strip draws the handoff like a drop.

panels.composition: A college hallway. The INSTRUCTOR walking fast with a heavy book under her arm. WOOD coming the other way.

image.prompt: a woman instructor walking fast down a college hallway with a heavy book under her arm toward a young man, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The book passing between them without either stopping. Like a drop.

image.prompt: close on a heavy book passing from a woman's hands to a young man's in a hallway as they pass each other, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The instructor, past him, not turning.

balloons.text: Two weeks. I never did this.

image.prompt: a woman instructor walking away down a hallway speaking over her shoulder, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood alone in the hall with the book. Its due-date card in the pocket: her name as blocks. Two weeks.

image.prompt: a young man alone in a college hallway holding a heavy library book with a due-date card visible in its pocket, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'I never did this.' 'Exactly.' The book on her card.
